self-educated.definition: s. educated by your own efforts rather than by formal instruction
self-educated.translation: a. 自修的, 自我教育的

self-education.definition: n the process of educating yourself

self-effacement.definition: n withdrawing into the background; making yourself inconspicuous
self-effacement.translation: n. 自我轻视, 谦逊

self-effacing.definition: s reluctant to draw attention to yourself
self-effacing.translation: a. 不出风头的, 不喜出风头的, 谦让的

self-elected.translation: a. 自我选举的, 自己选自己的

self-employed.translation:
a. 自己经营的, 不受雇于他人的, 非为雇主工作的, 不专为某一雇主工作的
[经] 个体经营者, 自我雇佣者

self-employment income.translation: [经] 自营职业收益, 个人经营者所得

self-enclosed.definition: s of self-imposed enclosure or confinement

self-energizing.translation: a. 自激的, 自身供给能量的, 自给供电的, 自身增大动力的

self-energizing resilient metal gaskets.translation: [化] 自紧式弹性金属垫片

self-enforcing.translation: a. 自我强制的, 本身具有强制力的

self-enrichment.translation: n. 自修学问, 自我修养

self-esteem.definition: n. a feeling of pride in yourself
self-esteem.translation: n. 自尊, 自负, 自大

self-evident.definition: s evident without proof or argument
self-evident.translation:
a. 不言自明的
[法] 不证自明, 不言而喻的

self-examination.definition: n the contemplation of your own thoughts and desires and conduct

self-examinations.definition:
plural of self-examination
n the contemplation of your own thoughts and desires and conduct
self-examinations.translation: (self-examination 的复数) n. 反省, 自省

self-examining.definition: a given to examining own sensory and perceptual experiences

self-excitation.translation:
n. 自激
[电] 自激发

self-executing.translation:
a. 自动生效的
[法] 不需补充立法即可生效的

self-exile.translation: n. 自我流放; 自我流放者

self-exiled.translation: a. 自我流放的, 自愿背井离乡的

self-existent.definition:
a. Existing of or by himself,independent of any other
   being or cause; -- as, God is the only self-existent being.
self-existent.translation: a. 自存的, 独立存在的

self-explaining.definition:
a. Explaining itself; capable of being understood
   without explanation.
self-explaining.translation: a. 不解自明的, 不需要解释就清楚的, 毋须解释的, 意义明显的, 显然的

self-explanatory.translation:
a. 自明的, 不需加以说明的
[法] 不言而喻的, 不言自明的

self-explantory.translation: [经] 不言自明的, 无需解释的, 显然的

self-exploration.translation: n. 自我探索（指对自己精神和智力上的潜在能力的省察和分析）

self-expression.definition: n. the expression of one's individuality (usually through creative activities)

self-expressive.translation: a. 自我表现的；自我表达的
